QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #3
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol received a request to build an equipment, and entrusted me to do the job for him. Karl from Ludibrium is the one that made the request. Wow, so I'm finally getting a legitimate request like this? Time to really put in my A-game!\n\n#i4001176# #t4001176# #b#c4001176# / 10
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from Ludibrium to build a shovel, and he asked me to do it for him. I tried my best, but all I got in return was a snide remark from Keol.

0.0: We received an order from the toy factory in Ludibrium. As you can see, Ramain, Moren and I are bombarded with work right now, so I want you to take care of this. It's not hard to make it; it's just a huge order, that's all. If you can't make it, then that's fine. We have plenty of no-good new item-producers that Moren always seem to bring in.

yes.0: The request is written in the purchase order. You need to make #b10 #t4001176#s#k that the Roly-Poly workers will use. Make sure to make it as sturdy as possible, since those are used for the renovation of Eos Tower. understand?

no.0: Do what you want to do. I knew you'd quit anyway.

1.0: Did you make them? It looks like you did make 10 of them... good, I'm going to notify Manager Karl that they are ready. You know you'll be solely responsible if any of those shovels are at fault, right? Now, as for the fee... choose the reward you want. This is your lucky day.

item.0: Are you sure you read the purchase order I gave you? What part of #b10 #t4001176#s#k do you not remember?? Your head's there for a reason.

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
